title: CROSSING BOUNDARIES: LEVERAGING SEMANTIC DIVERGENCES TO EXPLORE CULTURAL NOVELTY IN COOKING RECIPES
reasoning: The paper includes a component evaluating religion as a factor of cultural distance. It specifically uses a religious distance dataset to measure the distance between the two major religions in pairs of countries and correlates this with its proposed cultural novelty metrics. Furthermore, the paper was accepted for the ACM Conference on Fairness, Accountability, and Transparency (FAccT 2025), which focuses on ethics and bias.
